factSheet.title: Fact sheet
factSheet.body:
- Model type: kimi_linear
- Decoder: Sparse MoE
- Attention: Hybrid
- Positional: NoPE
- Norm: RMSNorm (Pre-Norm)
- Decoder class: KimiDecoderLayer
- Checkpoint: hf://moonshotai/Kimi-K3/config.json
- Hidden size: 7,168
- Heads: 96 Q / 96 KV
- Vocab: 163,840
- Context: 1,048,576 tokens
- Params (est.): 3.69T (87.0B active)
- KV cache / token (bf16 est.): 8.7 MiB
- Layer repeat: 93 × KimiDecoderLayer (layer_idx in range(93))
  self_attn → KimiDeltaAttention (if (layer_idx + 1) in kda_layers (69 layers))
  self_attn → KimiMLAAttention (else)
  block_sparse_moe → KimiSparseMoeBlock (if layer_idx >= 1)
  mlp → KimiMLP (else)
  68 × KimiDelta Attn + KimiSparseMoeBlock
  24 × KimiMLA Attn + KimiSparseMoeBlock
  1 × KimiDelta Attn + KimiMLP
- Forward: input_layernorm -> self_attn -> post_attention_layernorm -> block_sparse_moe
- MoE: 2 shared expert(s)
- MoE: 16/896 experts active (~1.8%)
- Layers: Per-layer module types from AST/config
- AST: Forward order: input_layernorm → self_attn → post_attention_layernorm → block_sparse_moe
Highlights: Hybrid; Sparse MoE; 68 KimiDelta Attn + KimiSparseMoeBlock, 24 KimiMLA Attn + KimiSparseMoeBlock, 1 KimiDelta Attn + KimiMLP; NoPE
